definitions.gloss: commuting expenses; commuting allowance; transportation costs to and from work
definitions.explanation: The money spent on transportation between home and the workplace. In Japan, employers typically reimburse this in full as a separate line item on the paycheck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
{通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二万円|にまんえん}ほど⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Commuting expenses come to about 20,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Full coverage of commuting expenses is an important condition when changing jobs.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (commuting) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expenses, fee). A standard item in Japanese employment terms. Usually reimbursed via a monthly commuter pass (⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧) or actual fare paid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧: provision of commuting expenses
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧: full commuting expenses covered
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧: to claim commuting expenses
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: commuting expenses included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧: transportation expenses — broader term, includes any work-related travel, not just commuting
- {通勤手当|つうきんてあて}: commuting allowance — the formal name on a paycheck
- {定期代|ていきだい}: cost of a commuter pass
